Definition: Total Pressures : Cumulative Sacks, Hits, and Hurries generated by the defender.
Sacks / Hits / Hurries : Standardized pressure metrics for defenders.
Tackles / Assisted Tackles : Total individual and shared defensive stops.
Missed Tackles / Missed Tackle Rate : Failed tackle attempts and their frequency.
Defensive Stops : A PFF Signature Stat. Tackles that constitute a "failure" for the offense based on yardage gained: <40% on 1st down, <60% on 2nd down, or <100% on 3rd/4th down.
Pass Breakups : Passes deflected or disrupted by a coverage player.
Longest : Longest reception allowed while in primary coverage.
Forced Fumbles : Total fumbles caused by the defender.
